tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// g.yu thog snying thig gi bka' srung zhang blon drag po sde dgu'i phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

g.yu thog snying thig gi bka' srung zhang blon drag po sde dgu'i phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sku baiḍūr lhun po ltar brjid mtshan dpe'i dra bas kun nas 'khyud// gang gsung yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan drang nges chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed// gang thugs zab gsal spros bral mkhyen brtse'i rol pa kun nas brjid// gang gi skyabs gcig 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal ba mthing mdog de la 'dud// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pa gso rig 'dzin cing g.yu thog snying thig la mos pa dag gis bka' srung zhang blon drag po sde dgu'i phrin las kyi rim pa la 'jug pa ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su sku'i mdun du gtor ma sman raka zan ling tshogs dang bcas pa sogs dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par byas la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hūm̐ */ rigs 'dus bla ma gu ṇa sman gyi bla// gso rig dam chos nyon mongs gdung ba sel// sman gyi drang srong 'phags mchog 'dus pa'i gtso// dkon mchog gsum la rtag par skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ bdag gis dus 'di nas ni byang chub bar// 'gro ba'i nyes gsum nyon mongs bsgral ba'i phyir// byang chub mchog rab smon 'jug byang chub sems// kun nas mi gtong brtan por bskyed par bgyi// lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag gzhan gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos dang chos can thams cad 'od gsal stong pa chen por 'jam klas pa'i ngang las/ rang rig hūm̐ hrīḥyig dmar po me dpung 'bar ba lta bur gyur pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma bdud bzhi'i gdan la| rang rig hūm̐ hrīḥde bab pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid snang ba'i cha dpa' bo rta mgrin sku mdog dmar zhing gzi brjid 'bar ba/

zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum sdang mig nyi ma ltar 'bar ba/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom me ltar mched cing 'bar ba/ spyi gtsug tu rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma le brgan dbang gi mdog can rta skad 'tsher ba// phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag dang zhag gis bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs dor stabs su bsgyings pa'i pang du stong pa'i mdangs yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo rtsa zhal khro chags rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po khro zhing ngur sgra 'byin pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug gdengs shing g.yon thod khrag yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ gcer mo skra grol ba thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ yab yum ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i klong na gnas pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla ba bdag bskyed do// bgegs gtor spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs shing bka' bsgo ba ni/ rol mo drag po dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni dbang gi khro bo che// rta mgrin rgyal po bgegs kyi gshed// gsang sngags las la mi dbang ba'i// bgegs dang log 'dren dam sri rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di khyer la// gang 'dod gnas su da dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na// dbang chen khros pa'i pho nya yis// bgegs kyi lus sems brlag par byed// de bas dengs shig dga' bar byos// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba karma ka ra sarba bhū ta uts+tsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshams bcad pa ni/ e ma nga ni rang byung ba| |ma skyes skye med dbang gi lha// thugs srog hrīḥyi spro bsdu las// khro bo khro mo khro chung gis// nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang khengs// kun kyang mi zad mtshon cha 'phen/ gri gug rdo rje rin po che// pad+ma rgya gram ral gri sogs// sna tshogs mtshon cha'i gur khang sra// ye shes me dpung kun nas 'bar// bgegs kyi sbyor ba mtshams chod cig

/hrīḥm/ rang rig gdod nas gzung 'dzin bral// nga dang bgegs kyi rtog pa spangs// thams cad mnyam nyid rang sems klong*// de la bgegs kyis ji ltar 'tshe// chos sku ye mtshams 'dod nas grub| |a la la hoḥ zhes brjod/ sman raka mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa rab tu brjid pa rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas kyis bltams pa dang*/ bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho rtsa brgyad yan lag stong du sbyar ba'i ra sā ya na rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can dang*/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i snying khrag rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po/ dmar mo gīrtī de wī rak+ta gsang ba'i dam rdzas kyi bcud dang ldan pa dang*/ gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin 'dod yon dam rdzas rmad du byung ba'i rdzas thams cad kyang ye shes kyi rol pa chen po'i rang rtsal las byung ba nyid du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shapada'i bar dang*/ pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba ling+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes gsum gyis byin brlabs// mdun bskyed ni// oṃ shū n+ya tās bsangs/ stong pa'i las rang gi mdun du e las drag po chos kyi dbyings mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i dbus su pad nyi dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la ma hā kā lā gdon sbyin chen po zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul sku mdog mthing nag rab khro 'jigs rung rngam pa'i lang tsho can/ phyag g.yas nor bu'i yu ba byas pa rgyas pa'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod rlon skra dang bcas pa'i nang du dgra bgegs kyi tsit+tas gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol ba mi mgo skam rlon gyis brgyan cing*/ tsan+dan gyi beng chen sked la 'chang ba/ myur mgyogs kyi rtsal ldan rta nag rting dkar rlung gi shugs can la zhon pa/

de dag gi mdun du sngags srung e ka dza ti mthing nag khros pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs khro mo'i cha lugs can// g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag thogs pa/ dre'u gwa dmar la bcibs pa'i snga shar mtshon gru dang phyi shar nad rkyal btags pa/ spyi bor zla tshes dang lte bar nyi mas brgyan pa ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor zhing me rlung dmar nag 'tshub ma'i nang du bzhugs pa/ g.yas su khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la dud kha sku stod khro bo dbu dgu bya rog gi zhal can dang bcas pa sku smad dug sbrul du 'khyil ba/ g.yas sbrul zhags dang g.yon rwa'i mda' gzhu thogs pa/ 'jigs rung mig stong 'bar ba chu srin mgo dgu la zhon pa sde brgyad bran du khol ba sprin nag gi klong na gnas pa/ rgyab tu mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ce spyang rab tu khros pa'i gdong can khrag ral sprugs pas dgra bgegs la nad yams kyi skal pa 'bebs pa/ gcer mo nu ma 'phyang ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang dgra zor/ g.yon gnyis thod khrag dang rgyu zhags mi mgo 'phyar zhing dur bya mgo dgu la zhon pa dur khrod yongs kyi bdag mor gyur/ g.yon du gnod sbyin shan pa dmar po khrag gi mdog can stag gdong rab tu khros pa/ phyag g.yas zangs gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod cing g.yon dgra snying dang rgyu ma dron mo thogs pa mi snying gi phreng bas lus brgyan pa/ g.yu 'brug rngam pa la zhon pa rang gi sprul pa grangs med pas bskor ba ste stong gsum gyi bdag por gyur/ mdun g.yas kyi mtshams su dam can srog gi spu gri mthing nag rab tu khro zhing 'jigs pa'i gzugs can srin po'i zhal rngam brjid 'bar zhing g.yo ba/ g.yas lcags kyu dang spu gri/ g.yon thod pa dam nyams pa'i glo snying gis gang ba thogs pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol zhing mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ seng chen kha gdangs khros pa la zhon nas skye 'gro yongs kyi srog gi bdag po byed pa/

g.yas rgyab kyi mtshams su srin po dgra dur 'jigs byed dmar nag khro gtum rab 'jigs zhal bgrad pa'i yas kyi mche ba brang gi lhan sna dang*/ mas kyi mche ba dpral ba'i dbyings su gzings pa mi ro chem chem du za ba'i spyi bor spyang mo kha gdangs pas nga ro sgrog pa/ g.yas ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon rtse gsum dang rgyu zhags thogs pa/ mi lpags rlon pa gyon nas ro langs mgo dgu la zhon pa/ keng rus gar byed pa grangs med pas bskor zhing phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs kyi gshed ma chen po byed pa/ rgyab g.yon gyi mtshams su bdud mo shan+ti ro zan ma dud kha rab tu khros shing mi sdug 'jigs su rung ba bya rgod kyi gdong can/ mche gtsigs spyan dmar khrag gi ral ba sprug cing nu ma 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas rgyu zhags dang dgra sta 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon tsit+ta bsnams nas lcags spyang mgo dgu la zhon pa/ dgra bgegs ma lus skad cig la sgrol ba/ g.yon mdun gyi mtshams su srog bdag hab se dug ha la'i mdog ltar gnag pa/ rab khros 'jigs rung zhal gcig pa/ spyi bor khra'i mgo bo cher rgod pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis mdung dang dug rkyal 'og ma gnyis mi mgo rlon pa dang phur pa thogs nas dred mo mgo dgu la zhon zhing dam nyams thams cad kyi gshed mar gyur pa/ de dag thams cad nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od ltar 'bar ba/ khro gtum rngam 'jigs ma rungs pa/ snying rje med cing gsod la dga' ba/ mi'i sha khrag la dga' zhing gsur chen gyi dri tshor ba tsam gyis rkan rdeb cing bzod glags med pa/ skad cig re re la'ang sprul pa dang yang sprul nying sprul pho nya nyi zer gyi rdul gyi grangs las 'das pa phyogs bcur 'gyed nus pa/ khams gsum srid gsum thams cad nyul zhing legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin/ dam tshig gi rjes gcod/ bstan dgra gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlog par byed cing*/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i bka' nyan gsung sdod ci bcol las kyi pho nya thogs rdugs med par gyur/

bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon dang mdun bskyed gtso 'khor rnams kyi gnas gsum nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang rang gi gnas nas sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran pa'i dbang gis skad cig la glog 'gyu ba ltar gshegs shing spyan drangs par gyur par bsam la/ gsur chen gyi dud pa btang*/ rol mo dang bcas gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi// tshur gshegs bka' srung spyan 'dren no// stobs ldan sde dgu 'khor dang bcas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ hūm̐ */ dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas 'dir| |sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i klong*// bstan bshig ma rungs bsgral ba'i steng*// bka' srung 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu rtsal can// 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin// dus las mi 'da' dam nyams snying 'byin pa// dam can chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// a ti pū hoḥ hūm̐ */ zhing bcu bsgral ba'i khrag rnams mtsho chen 'khyil// dbang po sna lnga'i me tog gcal du bkram// gsur chen bdug spos dud pa sprin ltar gtibs// zhun chen snang gsal mar me nyi bas gsal// rdo rje dri chus byugs pa'i rdzing bu mdzes// don snying sha rus zhal zas ri ltar spungs// thod rnga rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog /rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang med| |sman raka gtor tshogs spyan gzigs longs spyod rnams// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bde ba'i mchog /bka' srung drag po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las myur du sgrubs/ rang rang rtsa sngags sham bu ru/ ma hā gu ru/ muṃ laṃ/ ma hā kā lā/ e ka dzā ti/ ke ta ke ta/ ḍā ki nī/ yak+sha tsit+ta/ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya/ rak+ṣa rā dza dun+ti tsit+ta ka la sha/ tri baṃ rbad bh+yo/

dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra bhū mi pa ti ar+ghaṃ nas/ shapada'i bar dang*/ rū pa nas/ sa ma ye hūm̐/ ma hā sarba pañtsa sogs bdud rtsi/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ba ling+ta/ dgra bo'i ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta keṃ ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha truṃ i daṃ gṛh+ṇa swā hā/ sarba pū dza bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya hoḥ de nas khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ brub khung du dgra bo gsal btab la/ dbyangs kyi nga ros 'di skad do// hūm̐ */ dam nyams gnod byed ru tra bsgral ba yi// gzugs phung mchod par 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// phyi yi dbang po rnam lnga mchod par bzhes// nang gi don snying rnam lnga mchod par bzhes// gsang ba'i bla tshe srog dbugs mchod par bzhes// klad rus rkang dang khong khrag mchod par bzhes// ri rab skur bzhengs gnam sa'i zhal phyes la| |gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig /stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus stobs// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// rings par bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// gdon sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul zhal phyes la// gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig /stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus stobs// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol| |zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// rings par bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi| |ma gcig e ka dza ti zhal phyes la// gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig /stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus stobs// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// rings par bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// gza' bdud rā hu la yi zhal phyes la// gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig

/stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus stobs// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// rings par bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// mkha' khro ce spyang mchu dmar zhal phyes la// gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig /stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus stobs// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// rings par bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag zhal phyes la// gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig /stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus stobs// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// rings par bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// don dam srog gi spu gri zhal phyes la// gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig /stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus stobs// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// rings par bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi /srin po ro langs 'jigs byed zhal phyes la// gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig /stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus stobs// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// rings par bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// bdud mo ro zan nag mo zhal phyes la// gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig

/stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus stobs// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// rings par bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// las mkhan hab se chen po zhal phyes la// gangs dkar mche gtsigs glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig /stong gsum mid par dgra bgegs ma lus stobs// 'dod chags khrag la lcib lcib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la khrum khrum dgyes par rol// gti mug sha la chem chem dgyes par rol// zhal dang mgul du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// rings par bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// lo dang zla bar ma bzhag myur du sod// zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang myur du sod// 'go ba'i lha lnga skyob pa'i sman lnga phrol// za 'dre shi gshed gnod pa'i bdud dang sprod| |dam nyams pha tshan nang rme shi 'dzing thong*// ngu 'bod gnam 'debs brang chen brdung du chug /glo bur rims nad drag po char ltar phob// snying du sdug pa'i chung ma mal du sod// yid la brtse ba'i bu chung pang nas phrogs// brtsegs pa'i mkhar shigs bsags pa'i nor rdzas gtor// btab pa'i lo la 'bru than sad ser thong*// za ba'i zas la mu ge'i bskal pa phyo// mdza' ba'i gnyen phrol lha yi dmu thag chod// rlung mkhris bad kan 'du ba khong nas dkrugs// khong khrag thang la bskyugs shing 'chi ru chug /smyo 'bog brgyal dang mdze 'bras gag lhog thong*// brgyad cu rtsa gcig ltas ngan char ltar phob// sum brgya drug cu'i ye 'drog ma lus thong*// bdun brgya nyi shu'i glo bur stabs nyes thong*// rnam brgyad dus min 'chi bas dam nyams sod// stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi phrin las thong*// gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas myur du chod// sa yi rten phur 'og tu drud nas phyung*/ */

kha lce bsod nams za thang mtha' nas bsdus// rgan rim sdong rgan 'gyel ltar yas nas sod// gzhon rim me tog skams ltar mas nas sod// dar ma dgra la phob bzhin bar du sod| |pho rgyud me la chu bzhin 'chi ru chug /mo rabs rtswa la zor bzhin 'chi ru chug /ban bon sgo nga rdab bzhin 'chi ru chug /shi rgab nags la me bzhin mched du chug /gson rgab rtsa rul shing ltar 'phel ma 'jug /pha ma pha spun zhang tsha so sor sod// bu dang tsha bo yang tsha'i rigs rgyud skums// bdun rgyud rtsad chod thal ba rlung la bskur// sngon gyi rgyal ba rigs 'dus bka' ma bcag /phyi rabs sngags 'chang dam ldan bstan pa srungs// da lta rig 'dzin bdag gi ngag ma 'gal// thugs dam zhal bzhes gnyen po dran mdzod la// bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod// ces bstabs de nas bstod bsnyen sgrub/ 'bod rbad bsad pa'i las kha bsgyur// bskul zhing dam la gnas par bya// gdung ba'i yid dang snyan pa'i dbyangs// rol mo bcas pas 'di skad do/ */ hūm̐ */ chos kyi dbyings nas 'gag med skur bstan pa// rdo rje bdud 'dul gnod sbyin chen po'i sku// 'jigs rung mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis brjid// nor bu gri gug thod pa dgra snying bsnams// dar nag ber gsol mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// tsan+dan beng btsugs rta nag rting dkar bcibs// bstan pa gnyan srung bka' yi bya ra mdzod// chos skyong yongs kyi rje la phyag 'tshal bstod// bh+yoḥ ma gcig dpal ldan e ka dzā ti ma// mthing nag rab khros spyan gsum mche bzhi gtsigs// khro mo'i chas rdzogs phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin// dre'u zhon zhing mtshon gru nad rkyal btags// snyan g.yas seng chen g.yon pa sbrul nag 'phyo// spyi bor zla tshes lte bar nyi mas brgyan// me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na dgra bgegs sgrol// dam ldan bu bzhin skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */

bstan srung khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la// dud kha rab khros sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil// dbu dgu'i gtsug na bya rog mgo yis brgyan// g.yon pa sbrul zhags rwa yi mda' gzhu 'dzin// mgo lus mig gang sprin zhon kun tu nyul// sde brgyad bran 'khol mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bdag /dam ldan skyong zhing dam nyams srog rtsa gcod// drag po'i gtso bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ gnas dang yul gyi sha za mkha' 'gro'i gtso// rab 'jigs dmar mo ce spyang mgo dgu ma// khrag ral sprugs pas stong gsum nad kyis 'gengs// gcer bu rgyan med nu ma thur du 'phyang*// phyag bzhi dang po gri gug thod khrag gdengs// 'og gnyis dgra zor rgyu zhags mi mgo 'phyar| |dur bya mgo dgu zhon nas dur khrod nyul// dam nyams rtsad gcod gtso bor phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ gnod sbyin shan dmar dam nyams srog gcod gtso// mtshal mdog stag gdong zangs gri dgra snying gdengs// rgyu ma za zhing snying phreng ga shar gyon// g.yu 'brug zhon nas skad cig stong khams bskor// rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag med phyogs bcur 'gyed// nyin bzhin dregs pa pho rgyud bran du 'khol// mtshan bzhin mo rgyud thams cad dbang du sdud// bka' 'das gshed ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ bka' srung dam can srog gi spu gri ni| |mthing nag rab khros 'jigs rung rngam pa'i zhal// spyan dmar smin ma skra ser gyen du 'bar// lcags kyu spu gri dgra bo'i glo snying bsnams// dar nag ber gsol mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// seṅge zhon nas stong khams kun tu nyul// sprul pa yang sprul dgra srog chu bzhin 'thung*// zlog med 'gras phung nag por phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ srin po'i rgyal po dgra 'dul 'jigs byed ni// dmar nag rab 'jigs khro gtum srin po'i zhal// mche ba brang slebs mi ro zhal du gsol// spyi bor spyang mo kha gdangs nga ro sgrog

/ral gri rtse gsum rgyu zhags nam mkhar 'phyar// mi lpags gyon nas ro langs mgo dgu zhon// 'khor du keng rus gar byed rgod pas bskor// dam nyams rtsad gcod gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ shan+ti ro zan bdud mo bya rgod mgo// dud mdog mche gtsigs khrag ral phyogs bcur sprug /mi gdug nu ma brang gi ngos la 'phyang*// gcer bu mi lpags snying phreng ga shar gyon// g.yas g.yon rgyu zhags dgra sta dgra snying 'phyar// spyang mo mgo dgu zhon nas stong gsum nyul// skad cig re la dgra srog 'bum 'bum gcod/ rnal 'byor srung ma'i gtso mo khyod la bstod// hūm̐ */ rgyal ba'i bstan srung las mkhan dgra bo'i gshed// srog bdag hab se ha la nag po'i mdog /rab 'jigs khro zhal gtsug na khra mgo rgod// mche gtsigs dug rlangs na bun dgra bo gsod// phyag bzhi dang po mdung dar dug rkyal bsnams// 'og ma phur bu dam nyams mgo rlon za// dred mo mgo dgu chibs nas stong khams nyul// rnal 'byor grogs mdzad dgra gshed phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ kun 'dus rgyal ba bla ma'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas srog gi snying po phul// sgrub pa'i sku dgra bsgral ba'i mna' phul ba// dam can bka' srung sde dgu 'khor dang bcas// sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po dran mdzod la// rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod pa bzhes// bos pa'i dus su ma thogs myur du byon// rbad tshe mngags pa'i las rnams myur du sgrubs// zhes bstod/ bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'i dbus su gtso bo la hūm̐/ e ka dzā ti la maṃ/ gza' la ra/ ce spyang ma la hrīḥ shan dmar la k+ṣa/ dam can la tri/ srin po la ra/ bdud mo la dun/ srog bdag la shaṃ rnams kyi mthar rang rang gi srog sngags kyis bskor ba sngags dang sa bon thams cad rang rang gi mdog mtshungs su gsal ba/

rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros zhang blon gyi thugs ka'i srog snying la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ zhang blon gyi thugs srog las 'od 'phros 'khor rnams kyi srog snying la phog pas rgyud bskul 'khor thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing bka' nyan par gyur par bsam/ oṃ ma hā kā lā yak+sha tsit+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ rat+na sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhang blon gyi'o// oṃ e ka dzā ti ma ma ru lu ru lu maṃ hūm̐ bh+yo/ ma mo'i 'o// oṃ ke ta ke ta swā hā/ rā hu la sa ma hūm̐/ khyab 'jug gi'o// ḍā ki nī tsit+ta rak+ṣa sa ma ya hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ ce spyang ma'o// yak+ṣa tsit+ta ma hā ru tra mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ shan dmar gyi'o// badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya a mu ka mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dam can gyi'o// rak+ṣa rak+ta rā dza sa ma ya dgra bo'i srog la hur thuṃ dzaḥ srin po'i 'o// dun+ti tsit+ta kā la dgra bo thuṃ ril mā ra ya rbad/ ro zan ma'i 'o// tri shaṃ rbad bh+yo ging ka ra dgra bo'i srog la hab hab| las mkhan gtso bo hab se'o// de ltar gtso bo gsum la 'bum tsho gsum/ gzhan rnams la re re ni bsnyen pa'o// sgrub pa ni/ gzhung du/ sgrub dus dben pa'i gnas mchog tu// sku rten dar nag ma nyams pa// dri khrag tshon sbyar rang rang gi| |sku gzugs bris pa'i phyar dar ni// rab gnas mnga' gsol byas la bkram// gsung rten thod rnga mi rkang dung*// gsang ba'i rnga sogs rol mo bsags// thugs rten gri rgod gsang ba'i snying*// rtsa gsum ma nyams nang nyid du// mthing shog dag la gser dngul gyis// srog sngags bris la gzhug byas nas// ma nyams sgro sgron mda' dar la// dar nag btums la gdags par bya// bla rdo pha wang long bu la// gser gyis hūm̐ tri bris pa dang*// dngul gyi mo khab zab skud bcas// srog sngags bris pa dar snas btums// ga'ur bcug la ma bral bcang*// 'di yis mi 'bral grib ltar 'grogs// gzhan yang rta nag g.yag nag dang*// khyi nag bya nag g.yag lug nag

/gson po'i rten 'dzugs ma grub na// gsob bam yang na bris pa'ang rung*| /smyug tshal dar snas brgyan pa gzhug /rtags gtor rten gtor thun gtor dang*// mchod rdzas ci 'byor bsham par bya// zhes pa'i bar tshogs par bshams la/ rang gi thugs srog gi 'od kyis dam can 'khor bcas gyi srog snying drangs nas rang gi thugs srog la bsdus pas dbang du 'dus par bsam la/ de yang gzhung du sngags rnams dril la bzla bar bya// grangs tshad 'bum phrag gsum yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ oṃ ma hā kā lā yak+sha badz+ra tsit+ta/ e ka dzā ti ma ma ru lu maṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la/ ḍā ki nī tsit+ta rak+ta/ yak+sha tsit+ta ma hā ru tra/ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya/ rak+ṣa rak+ta rā dza/ dun+ti tsit+ta kā la/ tri shaṃ rbad bh+yo ging ka ra hab hab sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhriṃ hriṃ/ zhes 'bum phrag gsum bzla'o// gtor ma 'bul skabs hriṃ phyi ma'i mthar/ i daṃ ba ling+ta sarba pañtsa a mri ta ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ dbang bskur la hriṃ mthar/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ 'bod pa la sgrub sngags de nyid rang ngo*// rbad pa la dzaḥhriṃ bzhi re re dor nas hriṃ mthar/ rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo ya/ bsad pa la ya'i mthar/ dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya rbad sod hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so// bsrung ba la hriṃ mthar/ bdag gam yon bdag la srungs shig rak+ṣa swā hā/ zlog pa la hriṃ mthar gang bzlog par 'dod pa/ che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ bh+yo zlog sgyur/ ces so// thun mjug rnams su dam can sde dgu'i gdang bskang gdug pa tshar gcod nor bu 'od 'bar la 'bad do// de ltar bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rtags rnams dang*/ las sbyor sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi dang dmigs pa sngags la sogs pa ni/ byin rlabs bla sgrub kyi mchod bstod bskul gsum spu gri dug ngar zhes pa'i nang du zhal gsal gsungs pa la slob dpon dgyes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba las rtogs par byos shig /mthar brtan ma bskyang ba ni/

gtor ma la rak+ta bran/ dgug dbye bya/ slar me mar bltams/ sman raka sgron/ byin gyis brlabs shing dngos la bskul ba ni/ oṃ/ ka dag klong bzhugs kun 'dus rgyal ba'i tshogs// āḥ thugs rjes longs sprul gang 'dul skur bzhengs shig /hūm̐/ thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo 'gro don mdzod// hrīḥ dus la bab bo log rtog dgra bgegs sgrol// hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dbus nas rdo rje bdud 'dul bzhengs// gnod sbyin kun gyi ded dpon bskul// rta nag rlung gshog myur du skyod// gri gug 'bar bas dgra srog chod// gnod sbyin dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// bh+yoḥ shar nas e ka dzā ti bzhengs// ma mo kun gyi sde dpon bskul/ drel rta rlung gshog myur du skyod// nad rkyal dgra bo'i yul du phob// ma mo'i dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// hūm̐ bh+yoḥ lho nas gza' bdud chen po ni// sde brgyad kun gyi ded dpon bskul// sprin nag rlung gshog myur du skyod| |sbrul zhags rwa mda' dgra la rgyob// gza' yi dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nub nas ce spyang mchu dmar bzhengs// mkha' 'gro kun gyi ded dpon bskul// dur bya rlung gshog myur du skyod// dgra zor rgyu zhags dgra la phob// mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ */hūm̐ bh+yoḥ byang nas gnod sbyin shan dmar bzhengs// shan pa kun gyi ded dpon bskul// g.yu 'brug rlung gshog dgra srog chod// zangs gri dmar po dgra la phob// shan pa'i dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// hūm̐ bh+yoḥ

shar lho srog gi spu gri bzhengs// dam can kun gyi ded dpon bskul// seng chen rlung gshog dgra srog chod// lcags kyu spu gri dgra la rgyob// dam can dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// hūm̐ bh+yoḥ lho nub dgra dur 'jigs byed bzhengs// srin po kun gyi ded dpon bskul// ro langs rlung gshog dgra srog chod// ral gri rtse gsum dgra snying chod// srin po'i dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nub byang shan+ti ro zan bzhengs// bdud mo kun gyi ded dpon bskul// spyang mo rlung gshog dgra srog chod// dgra sta rgyu zhags dgra la phob// bdud kyi dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// hūm̐ bh+yoḥ byang shar srog bdag hab se bzhengs// las mkhan kun gyi ded dpon bskul// dred mo rlung gshog dgra srog chod// dug rkyal phur bu dgra la phob// las mkhan dmag tshogs dgra la phob// steng gi mi rabs rtsad nas chod// 'og gi nor phyugs rlung la bskur// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// hūm̐ bh+yoḥ 'jig rten mi bsrun dregs pa'i tshogs// dpal chen 'bar ba'i bka' byung gi// rang rang dmag dpung go mtshon skyod// thog rgod lta bur myur du rgyugs// gnod sbyin zhe sdang che ba'i tshogs// dam nyams yul khams thal bar rlogs// ma mo phrag dog che ba'i tshogs// nad rkyal dgra la char ltar phob// gza' bdud nga rgyal che ba'i tshogs// dug lnga dgra bo'i snying la rgyob// mkha' 'gro phrag dog che ba'i tshogs// mi rung sna tshogs dgra la thong*// shan pa srog la rngam pa rnams// dam nyams srog dbugs da lta chod// dam can dam nyams gshed ma'i tshogs// snying khrag dron mo myur du 'thung*// srin po sha khrag dga' ba'i tshogs// dam nyams sha khrag rus la rol// bdud mo ro la za byed rnams// dam nyams zas su da zo zhig

/srog bdag khrag la skem byed rnams// dam nyams khong khrag da 'thung zhig /sde brgyad dbugs la rngam pa rnams// dam nyams srog dbugs da 'gom zhig /srung ma dam la gnas pa rnams// dam nyams phung bar da gyis shig /bka' srung bka' bzhin sgrub pa rnams// bka' 'das rlog par da gyis shig /chos skyong chos byed skyong ba rnams// chos snub dam nyams da sgrol zhig /phyogs skyong bcu yi zhing bdag rnams// rnams// thul cig thul cig dgra dang bgegs// sod cig sod cig dam nyams 'di// chom zhig chom zhig sdig can 'di// zo zhig 'thung zhig sha dang khrag /khyer zhig gtor zhig dgra bo'i nor// shigs shig rgyel zhig dgra bo'i khyim// bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog /lo dang zla bar ma 'gyang zhig /zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang bar// dam nyams dgra bo 'khor bcas kyi// srung skyob dpung mgon byed pa rnams// stag tshubs se tshub// sbrul nag zhags pa na ra ra// thun gyi ser ba sha ra ra// khrag gi char pa si li li// nad kyi na bun thibs se thib// thog gi bu yug chi li li// rgyob dang sod sgra di ri ri// dam nyams ngu 'bod lhangs se lhang*// khrag gi rgya mtsho khol lo lo// sha yi ri bo zings se zing*// rus pa'i gram khrod khra la la// mi snyan nga ro tse re re// gcan gzan tshogs rnams zhungs se kyi gshin rje'i khram la thob// 'chi bdag sgo bro rdung du chug

/dus la bab bo sa ma ya// zhes brjod gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang*| g.yab mo rdeb cing 'o dod 'bod/ dam nyams rdul du brlag par bsam/ bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang rang gi phyogs la bab na ma gtogs mi bskul zer ro// zhes bskul zhing gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngam thebs 'og tu 'bul/ rjes su yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ dam can rnams bris sku la brtan bzhugs rab gnas bya/ shis brjod bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/ dus rtag tu dam rdzas mi la mi ston/ tshogs gtor dang bsnyen pa rgyun mi bcad/ sngar 'gras kyi mi dang snying mi bsre/ dam tshig nyams pa dang gtam mi smra/ ro dang mdze can yug grib 'dzem/ bya nag khyi nag la rdeg gsod spang*/ zla re'i dgu gtor la brtson par bya/ slob dpon gus shing mched lcam la 'dud pa dang*/ dam can la the tshom med pa'i yid ches bskyed pa rnams thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig yin pas bsrung ba gal che ba yin no// smras pa/ sman gyi bla ma sangs rgyas gu ṇa'i zhabs// bdag snying pad+mor sngon nas bzhugs pa'i mthus// gso rig gzhung lugs snying thig srung mar bcas// ma 'bad ngang gis rtogs pa'i yi rang dang*// deng sang sman par khas 'che rlom pa ni// bla sgrub rim gnyis nyams dang mi ldan pas// rang gzhan mchog don sgrub pa'i rtsa ba chad// dam can srung ma'i mthu rtsal ma bsgrub pas// zhe gnag dgra la dug mtshon sbyor ba rtsom// rgya bod mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs ma sbyangs par// man ngag dam dum tsam gyis rang gzhan bslu// brtan g.yo'i sman bcud ro nus ma rtogs par// ldam ldum 'ga' zhig tshod ma lta bur sdud// dpyad kyi lag len gang la'ang blo rmongs pas// rwa 'jib par bu lcags sreg tsam la re// cha dpyad rnam dpyod ldan pa ma mthong bas// btsag bu'i mig thur tsam gyi re ba gang*// bcos dgos brgya dang rtsa gcig nad mang la// sman nyog bsres pa'i ming snyan spyi 'joms zhes//

btags pas nad pa kun gyi srog gshed byed// 'chos mi dgos pa'i nad pa sos pa'i tshe// kho bos byas zhes sa steng dregs pas 'gengs// bcos dgos nad la sman lhag log pa yis// nad pa shi tshe las dang tshe zad zer// bcos tshul sde tshan lnga la sogs pa rnams// nad gcig steng du go rim ma log par// gzhung ltar mi byed gang dran gya tshom gyi// byol nyog spyad pas nad par mi sman tshe// dus ngan nad la gzhung gis mi phan zhes// dus gsum mkhyen pa rgyal ba sman gyi blas// ma 'ongs don phyir gsungs la bkur ba 'debs// de rjes 'brangs pa'i las ngan slob mar bcas// rang gzhan thams cad dmyal bar khyu 'ded byed// rang nyid gcig pus nad la phan mi thog /sman pa zla bo byung na dgra ltar 'dzin// nad ma sos par yon la sbar snying 'tham| |da lta nad par dngos su ma phan yang*// sngon chad 'di 'dra mang po phan no sogs// ngo tsha bral ba'i sbad kham 'ur gyis 'gengs// gzhung la ma sbyangs nad par mi phan zhing*// yod rlom mngon pa'i nga rgyal zol gyis bslu// zla grogs kun la chags sdang phrag dog pas// tshe 'dir kun gyis smod cing rang nyid ngal// phyi ma chags sdang phrag dog dbang gis ni// ngan song myong bas 'di phyi gnyis ka med// de 'dra'i sman pas nor 'dzin gzhi khengs pa// dus 'dir 'gro ba'i bsod nams skal re dman| |'on kyang sngon gyi smon sems dam pa'i mthus/ /'gro la sman pa'i 'tsho mdzad re re tsam/ /srid la lhag bsam dag pas mi mos gang*/ /de phyir gso rig srung ma gtso 'khor gyi/ /phrin las khrigs chags bgyis pa'i dge tshogs gang*// ma gyur 'gro ba'i nyes gsum nad zhi nas// sman gyi bla ma'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// de ltar g.yu thog snying thig gi bka' srung zhang blon drag po sde dgu'i phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ 'tsho mdzad dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/

dbur stod 'bri gung du son pa 'gru rgyal skyu ra'i rigs las/ don gyi sman pa shākya'i dge slong drang srong chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pas/ me spre'u dbo zla dmar po'i rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i dus tshes dge bar/ 'bri gung rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba 'dis kyang*/ gso ba rig pa'i gnas kyi don gyi bstan pa rab tu 'phel zhing lus can rnams nyes pa gsum gyi zug rngu bral te/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /zhang blon sde dgu la gtor ma dpal gtor gcig la rang 'dra chung ba brgyad dam// zur gsum la rang 'dra brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mtshams su mtheb skyu can dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
